Monograph Visual Theme for ggplot2

Source: R/dualplot.R
theme_monograph.Rd

Returns a clean, publication-ready ggplot2 theme featuring a white background, crisp dark border, optional grid lines, and serif typography.

Usage

theme_monograph(
  grid.type = c("none", "x", "y", "xy"),
  base_size = 11,
  base_family = "serif",
  base_line_size = base_size/22,
  base_rect_size = base_size/22,
  ...
)

Arguments

grid.type

character string specifying which grid lines to display: one of "none" (default), "x", "y", or "xy".

base_size

base font size in pts (default 11).

base_family

base font family (default "serif").

base_line_size

base size for line elements.

base_rect_size

base size for rectangle elements.

...

additional arguments passed to ggplot2::theme_light().

Value

A ggplot2 theme object.

See also

par_monograph

Examples

if (requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
  ggplot2::ggplot(cars, ggplot2::aes(speed, dist)) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(size = 2) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = "cars") +
    theme_monograph(grid.type = "xy")
}

if (requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
  ggplot2::ggplot(iris, ggplot2::aes(Petal.Length, Species)) +
    ggplot2::geom_boxplot() +
    ggplot2::labs(title = "iris") +
    theme_monograph(grid.type = "x")
}
